    [0,3,6],[1,4,7],[2,5,8],       # horizontal
    [0,1,2],[3,4,5],[6,7,8],       # vertical
    [0,4,8],[1,5,6],[2,3,7],       # slope 1
    [0,5,7],[1,3,8],[2,4,6],       # slope 2
]
blocks = blocks * 3
assert len(blocks) == 36

for j, B in enumerate(blocks):

for j in range(b):

for i1 in range(v):

        s = sum(x[i1][j]*x[i2][j] for j in range(b))
        assert s == 3, (i1,i2,s)

flat = [x[i][j] for i in range(v) for j in range(b)]
